drivingQuestion: In each order of slaughtering a mother, daughter and granddaughter on one day, how many acts of transgression are counted?
outcomeNote: The mishna records the dispute without deciding it; the gemara takes up Sumakhos's reasoning in the next unit.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שָׁחַט פָּרָה וְאַחַר כָּךְ שְׁנֵי בָּנֶיהָ – סוֹפֵג שְׁמוֹנִים, שָׁחַט שְׁנֵי בָּנֶיהָ וְאַחַר כָּךְ שְׁחָטָהּ – סוֹפֵג אֶת הָאַרְבָּעִים, שְׁחָטָהּ וְאֶת בִּתָּהּ וְאֶת בַּת בִּתָּהּ – סוֹפֵג שְׁמוֹנִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If «one slaughtered a cow and thereafter» slaughtered «its two offspring» on the same day, «he incurs eighty» lashes for two separate actions violating the prohibition against slaughtering the mother and the offspring on the same day. If «one slaughtered its two offspring and thereafter slaughtered» the mother cow, «he incurs the forty» lashes, as he performed a single prohibited act. If «one slaughtered» the mother «and its daughter, and,» later that day, slaughtered «its daughter’s daughter, he incurs eighty» lashes, as he has performed the act of slaughtering a mother and its offspring twice.

segments.he: שְׁחָטָהּ וְאֶת בַּת בִּתָּהּ, וְאַחַר כָּךְ שָׁחַט בִּתָּהּ – סוֹפֵג אֶת הָאַרְבָּעִים. סוֹמְכוֹס אוֹמֵר מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי מֵאִיר: סוֹפֵג שְׁמוֹנִים.
segments.en: But if «one slaughtered» the mother «and its daughter’s daughter and thereafter slaughtered its daughter, he incurs the forty» lashes, as he performed a single prohibited act. «Sumakhos says in the name of Rabbi Meir: He incurs eighty» lashes for slaughtering the daughter on the same day as its calf and its mother, as that act comprises two separate violations of the prohibition.

moves.cueHe: שחט פרה ואחר כך שני בניה – סופג שמונים
moves.summary: the counts of lashes for slaughtering a cow before or after its offspring

moves.cueHe: שחטה ואת בת בתה, ואחר כך שחט בתה – סופג את הארבעים
moves.summary: mother, then granddaughter, then daughter yields forty lashes
moves.about: Sumakhos reports R' Meir's ruling of eighty lashes for slaughtering the daughter last

moves.cueHe: סומכוס אומר משום רבי מאיר: סופג שמונים
moves.summary: Sumakhos, in R' Meir's name, counts that last slaughter as two transgressions
moves.about: whether one who slaughtered the cow, then its daughter's daughter, and then its daughter incurs forty lashes or eighty for that last act

edges.about: Sumakhos reports R' Meir's ruling of eighty lashes for slaughtering the daughter last

edges.cueHe: סופג את הארבעים. סומכוס אומר משום רבי מאיר: סופג שמונים
edges.about: whether one who slaughtered the cow, then its daughter's daughter, and then its daughter incurs forty lashes or eighty for that last act
